mapper.select: SELECT r.CALC_TYPE AS calcType, r.ITEM_CD AS itemCd, r.APPLY_DT AS applyDt, r.SECTION_AMT AS sectionAmt, r.RATE_VAL AS rateVal, r.ADD_AMT AS addAmt, r.RMK AS rmk FROM LAW_CALC_RATE r JOIN ( SELECT CALC_TYPE, NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN APPLY_DT <= #{baseDt} THEN APPLY_DT END), MIN(APPLY_DT)) EFF_DT FROM LAW_CALC_RATE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY CALC_TYPE ) eff ON eff.CALC_TYPE = r.CALC_TYPE AND r.APPLY_DT = eff.EFF_DT WHERE r.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY r.CALC_TYPE, NVL(r.SECTION_AMT, -1), r.ITEM_CD

SELECT APPLY_DT AS "applyDt", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM LAW_CALC_RATE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
GROUP BY APPLY_DT ORDER BY APPLY_DT DESC

SELECT RATE_ID AS rateId, CALC_TYPE AS calcType, ITEM_CD AS itemCd, APPLY_DT AS applyDt, SECTION_AMT AS sectionAmt, RATE_VAL AS rateVal, ADD_AMT AS addAmt, RMK AS rmk, USE_YN AS useYn FROM LAW_CALC_RATE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND APPLY_DT = #{applyDt}
ORDER BY CALC_TYPE, NVL(SECTION_AMT, -1), ITEM_CD
SELECT MAX(APPLY_DT) FROM LAW_CALC_RATE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE LAW_CALC_RATE SET USE_YN = 'N', UPD_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE APPLY_DT = #{applyDt}
